name: Youth Legislative Assembly
what_you_do: Take part in a mock legislative session with other high school students. You debate and vote on issues about local, state and national government.
who_can_apply: Any high school student in good standing at a public, private, charter or home school in North Carolina. You do not need a legislator to sponsor you.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page.
duration: A conference of about three days (March 5 to 7, 2027)
deadline_text: The application is available now. No deadline is listed. The page says the next conference is March 5 to 7, 2027, but its heading still says 2025-26, so confirm the year with the coordinator.
how_to_apply: Complete the student application on the YLA page. If the form does not load, call the program coordinator, Erica Gallion, at (919) 301-1372.
notes: The page does not say what it costs or when it is due. Call the coordinator before you plan.
